acceptanceCriteria: A read verb (e.g. dispatch status --worker or attempt show) shows the current context notice.
Detached-run handoff records reason CONTEXT with contextTokens and hardTokens, same as the attached path; focused test.
body: Found by lane V1-1549 (dispatch context thresholds, PR beamfall/corvint#1016, head 4f95382a4, base 69c6cac03, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. Workers must read the CORVINT_DISPATCH_CONTEXT_FILE record themselves; no corvint-tasks verb shows the warn/handoff notice. The detached-run handoff path does not carry the CONTEXT reason, contextTokens and hardTokens detail. Expected: notice readable through a verb and the same handoff detail on both paths.
title: Surface dispatch context notices through a corvint-tasks verb and carry the CONTEXT detail on detached handoff
